description: Authenticated state change for an existing recurring paid watch. Set enabled=true to allow future scheduled runs under the watch's saved cadence and spending limits, or enabled=false to stop future runs; this does not create a watch or edit its query. Use create_recurring_paid_watch to create one and list_recurring_paid_watches to obtain an existing watch_id.

enabled.description: true enables future scheduled executions; false disables future scheduled executions for this watch.

watch_id.description: Existing recurring watch identifier, typically returned by create_recurring_paid_watch or list_recurring_paid_watches.

name: set_recurring_paid_watch
